topic: What to say when your teen says 'I'm bored' (script included)
caption:
Next time your teen says 'I'm bored,' try this script.

Look them in the eye and ask: 'What's one thing a neighbor would pay you $20 to do this weekend?' Then go quiet. Let them sit with it.

That pause is where confidence starts building.
